title: Two Hours of Sleep
about: Long State Arts-In days that stretched past midnight and started again around six in the morning, leaving almost no time to sleep.
description: This track remembers the exhausting pace of a State Arts-In year when responsibilities regularly continued past midnight and mornings began around six. Masks were another part of the routine, tasks seemed endless, and finishing one job usually meant finding the next one waiting. Two weeks could feel like two months when almost every ounce of energy was being spent. Looking back, the remarkable part isn't the exhaustion itself, but that despite running on almost no sleep, we kept showing up, doing the work, and somehow finding a way through each day.
lyrics: The clock had already passed midnight,
One more thing to make it through.
By the time the lights went out,
Close your eyes for just a moment...
The alarm would have its say.
Six o'clock comes way too fast,
You learn to keep on moving,
Running on two hours of sleep,
A way to lift me off the ground.
The days were long, the nights were short,
I don't know how we kept it going...
Masks were part of every morning,
Still the work kept rolling forward,
There wasn't much time left for breaks,
Always trying to do our best.
Though living it felt much more real.
Some things only make sense later,
Looking back at how they feel.
Running on two hours of sleep,
Before we knew another day was on.
The pace refused to let us rest.
Though you barely slept in bed.
The body says you've had enough,
The heart says one more day.
Running on two hours of sleep,
The sunrise came before we knew
The night had even ended through.
Looking back I still can't tell
All I know is we were there...
